**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

[Sir](../persons.html#981)
I am obliged to you for forwarding the cheque for[ £25](../others.html#160) for the first edition of the [Two Guardians](../books.html#13).
I am at present too much engaged to think of publishing anything in the [Churchman’s Companion](../others.html#62),[^1] though I am obliged to you for the proposal.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY had contributed The Two Guardians (1850-2) to The Churchman\'s Companion, published by Masters.
